text: Had two lectures in the morning and a lab after lunch. Took the 5:40 local back home and reheated yesterday's dal for dinner.
Spent most of the day sorting notes for the economics test. Stopped at the stationery shop to buy a new pen refill and a highlighter.
The bus took the longer route today because of road work near the station. Reached office at 9:30, answered emails, and had lunch at my desk.
Washed clothes, cleaned the desk, and paid the electricity bill online. Then I went through the grocery list for the weekend.
Attended the group project call at 4 pm. We split the slides into sections and agreed to meet again on Thursday.
The house felt painfully quiet after Dadi's phone call ended. I kept looking at her old photo and crying until my chest hurt.
I got the internship offer today and I couldn't stop smiling! I danced around my room and called everyone I know.
He took credit for my work in front of the whole team again. I'm so furious I can barely type this properly.
My hands were shaking as I waited outside the doctor's cabin. Every worst-case scenario kept running through my head.
Watching my sister laugh at her own joke made my heart feel so full. I'd do anything to keep her this happy.
I'm not happy with how the week went, even though everyone says it was a success. Something feels hollow.
I used to dread speaking in front of the class, but I'm no longer afraid of it. Today I finished my presentation without my voice trembling.
I was so worried about the results all morning, but now that I've seen them, I feel calm. Whatever comes next, I can handle it.
I'm not angry at Rhea anymore. The argument still sits in my mind, but the heat has gone out of it.
I didn't feel sad when the trip got cancelled, honestly. I just shrugged and started a new book.
Saying goodbye to my hostel friends made me tear up at the station. Still, I'm so thankful for these four years and everyone who made them special.
Tomorrow I move to a new city alone, and my stomach is in knots. But I'm also thrilled about starting something new.
I'm so annoyed that Papa never listens when I explain my side. Still, I know he stays up worrying about me, and I love him for it.
My best friend's wedding was beautiful and I cried happy tears. Walking home alone afterwards, I felt a little left behind.
I opened the door and the entire family was there for my birthday! I was stunned, and then I couldn't stop laughing.
